The Lightning Ascent is a stairway leading up from the Celestial Enclave to the Pinnacle of Storms in the Throne of Thunder. The walls are lined with an electrical defense system which activates soon after intruders begin the climb. A few doorways are found here, like in many parts of the fortress, which lead to unknown locations. There is a chance for a rare spawn and weekly quest to appear at the entrance of the stairway, Zao'cho the Wicked.

Lightforged Augment Rune is a reputation reward; you must be with the Army of the Light to purchase this item from Vindicator Jaelaana on the Vindicaar for . Lightforged draenei are a large faction of draenei who serve the Army of the Light and the Alliance. For untold millennia, the Army of the Light waged war against the Burning Legion throughout the Twisting Nether. The draenei most committed to their long crusade would undergo a ritual to become Lightforged, infusing their bodies with the very essence of the Holy Light. After finally achieving victory on Argus, the Lightforged draenei have undertaken a new mission: protecting Azeroth from rising threats, and helping their kin from the Alliance push back against Horde aggression. They became an allied race and pledged their loyalty to King Anduin Wrynn. They were introduced in Legion.
The Lightforged Felcrusher is a quest reward from For the Light! (quest)

The Lightbound are an army of draenei, Mag'har orcs, and ogres from led by High Exarch Yrel in service of the naaru. They waged war against the unified orc clans known as the for the safety of Draenor.

The Light Mother is a naaru who blessed High Exarch Yrel with visions after the War in Draenor, making her see that one day the Army of the Light would march across the Great Dark Beyond and bring order to countless troubled worlds. In order to ensure that the future promised by the naaru was fulfilled, the draenei started a campaign to unite and convert the Mag'har orcs into servitors of the Light. This was the birth of the Lightbound which led to the war between the Lightbound and the Mag'har.

The Lightning Blast 3000 is a mechanical device created by Sapphronetta Flivvers. When her marriage with Grizzek Fizzwrench went sour, Saffy repeatedly tried to hit her husband with the contraption, but it failed every time she took aim. Grizzek had previously told her that the "piece of crap" wouldn't work. Sometime around or after the Argus Campaign, Saffy managed to get the Lightning Blast 3000 working. However, she didn't bring it with her on the Explorers' League and Sentinel expedition to Silithus, which she regretted when the camp was attacked by Bilgewater Cartel goblins. .]] Lion's Pride Inn (also known as the Goldshire Inn) is an inn found in the town of Goldshire, in Elwynn Forest. According to Innkeeper Farley, the inn's motto is "Rest and relaxation for the tired and cold." The inn has been run by the Farley family for years, since the time of King Llane Wrynn I, and they take great effort to run an above-board business. Lion's Pride offers a wide range of services from class trainers and quest givers to drinks aplenty.

Limited supply items, such as recipes, are sold in limited quantities from vendors. Once the supply has been exhausted, the item will not be available from that vendor for anywhere from a few seconds to several hours. If you are waiting for a limited supply item to become available, keep in mind that you must close the vendor window and re-open it to see any newly-restocked patterns.

Limpy Joe was a friend of Hugh Glass. The mentally unstable Hugh speaks inconsistently about Joe: he claims that the "wolfmen" got Joe and Flannel McGee, while Hugh himself managed to escape from the monsters with Griselda. However, upon meeting adventurers, Hugh mistakes them for Joe and asks them to limp down to the Eastwind Shore to get some fish for Griselda. When the adventurers return, Hugh changes his mind again and instead accuses them of being Joe's murderer, then threatens them into leaving.

The original lion's ring was crafted by Urtis, a low-ranking sorcerer known for his indecisiveness. Urtis never rose highly in the ranks like most of his fellows, but some of the items he created live on today, and several more that he did not create bear his name if only because they seem, like him, unable to decide what their treu function is. The ring's golden band bears an intricately carved lion's head that holds a half-inch jewel in its mouth. The type of the gem cannot be determined, and in fact seems to shift and change in color and consistency from moment to moment.

A lightning net is a normal net woven with copper strands that stretch back along the control rope to an electrical battery pack worn around the wielder's waist. When a target becomes entrangled in the net, the wielder can press a stud on the rubber-coaded control rope to release the batteries' charge into the net.

Liogela (real name unknown) is a QA representative for Blizzard Entertainment. Liogela is known to post in the Mobile Bug Report forum. The name "Liogela" appears to be an anagram for Galileo, which may also explain this moderator's avatar - an image of a staff with animations of small objects orbiting larger ones.

Lion's Landing is a newly constructed Alliance base on the southern coast of Pandaria. It has been built in Krasarang Wilds on the eastern side of Krasarang Cove. The area phases in upon completion of Lion's Landing (quest), the third quest in a series dealing with Operation: Shieldwall, the Alliance operation in Pandaria. Besides its port, the base is made up of a keep, barracks and a lighthouse. Just next to its perimeter is a quarry, and the stone here is especially tough - the mogu used it to fashion their constructs, and now the Alliance build its towers with it. The goblins of Domination Point want that stone to make bigger bombs.

Lion's Watch (or Lion's Stand) is the main Alliance base in Tanaan Jungle. It was established by the Alliance player and Exarch Yrel soon after landing in Tanaan Jungle to begin the final offensive against and the Iron Horde. The base is well fortified, with numerous cannon positions located around it. The outskirts, however, are shelled frequently by Iron Horde artillery. Lion's Watch acts as the main staging ground for the Alliance offensive against . Lion's Watch is also the de facto headquarters of the Hand of the Prophet.
